ns2:course.label: Equine Surgery Laboratory
ns2:course.description: Provides introductory laboratory experiences in common and basic equine surgical techniques. Topics include normal and cryptorchid equine castration, distal limb surgeries, casting techniques, and joint injections. Approved for S/U grading only. Prerequisite: VM 606.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Approved for S/U grading only. Prerequisite: VM 606.
ns2:course.sectionCappArea: Restricted to Vet Med Yr 3 students.
